welcome.name: Welcome
welcome.when: Right after someone creates an account.

magic_link.name: Sign-in link
magic_link.when: When someone signs in with an email link.

otp.name: Sign-in code
otp.when: When someone signs in with a one-time code.

password_reset.name: Password reset
password_reset.when: When someone asks to reset their password.

invitation.name: Invitation
invitation.when: When an admin invites someone to the workspace.

role_changed.name: Role changed
role_changed.when: When an admin changes someone's role.

trial_reminder.name: Trial ending
trial_reminder.when: 3 days before and when a hosted trial ends.

task_created.name: New task for you
task_created.when: When a task is created with you as the assignee.

task_assignee_changed.name: Task assigned
task_assignee_changed.when: When a task is assigned to someone.

task_status_changed.name: Task status changed
task_status_changed.when: When a task moves to another column.

task_comment.name: New comment
task_comment.when: When someone comments on a task.

task_mention.name: Mentioned in a task
task_mention.when: When someone @mentions a person in a comment or description.

task_deleted.name: Your task was deleted
task_deleted.when: When someone else deletes a task assigned to a person.

project_task_created.name: New task in your project
project_task_created.when: When someone adds a task by hand to a project.
project_task_created.who: The project team, except the creator and the assignee

project_task_deleted.name: Task deleted in your project
project_task_deleted.when: When someone deletes a task from a project (bulk deletes excluded).
project_task_deleted.who: The project team, except the person who deleted it and the assignee

due_date_reminder.name: Due soon
due_date_reminder.when: Before a task's due date (each person picks how early).

task_overdue.name: Overdue
task_overdue.when: When a task passes its due date unfinished.

time_entry_created.name: Time logged
time_entry_created.when: When someone logs time on a task.

chat_mention.name: Mentioned in chat
chat_mention.when: When someone @mentions a person in a chat conversation.

leave_withdrawn.name: Leave withdrawn
leave_withdrawn.when: When someone cancels a pending leave request.

leave_approved.name: Leave approved
leave_approved.when: When an approver approves the request.

leave_rejected.name: Leave declined
leave_rejected.when: When an approver declines the request.

expense_approved.name: Expense approved
expense_approved.when: When an approver approves the expense.

expense_rejected.name: Expense declined
expense_rejected.when: When an approver declines the expense.

expense_paid.name: Expense paid back
expense_paid.when: When payroll marks the expense paid.

payslip_ready.name: Payslip ready
payslip_ready.when: When a payroll run is approved.

task_due_today.name: Due today
task_due_today.when: The morning of the due day, at the start of the workday.

task_due_soon.name: Last call
task_due_soon.when: About two hours before the workday ends on the due day, if it's still open.

task_overdue_escalated.name: Overdue on your team
task_overdue_escalated.when: On the third workday late, then weekly, while it's still open.

daily_digest.name: Morning digest
daily_digest.when: Each workday at the start of the day, if something is due, late or new.

task_not_started.name: Not started
task_not_started.when: 2 workdays after a task is assigned, if the assignee hasn't touched it.

task_stuck.name: Stuck task
task_stuck.when: When a task in progress has no updates, comments or time for 3 workdays.

end_of_day.name: End of day
end_of_day.when: 30 minutes before the workday ends, if clocked in with no time logged.

team_summary.name: Weekly team summary
team_summary.when: The first workday of each week.

notificationPolicy.title: Notification rules
notificationPolicy.subtitle: Decide which notifications and emails people in {{workspace}} get. Everyone follows these automatically.
notificationPolicy.howDefault: With "Members can change" on, your choice is the default and each person can still turn it on or off for themselves.
notificationPolicy.howLocked: With it off, your choice applies to everyone and members can't change it.
notificationPolicy.readOnly: Only workspace admins can change these.
notificationPolicy.reset: Back to default (on, each person decides)

connect.description: Make a key, then paste one command into Claude Code. Works with Claude Desktop, Cursor and any MCP app too.
connect.name: Key name
connect.oauthHint: Add TeamOS without a key, then run /mcp inside Claude Code and sign in in the browser. Best for your own laptop; use a key for anything unattended.

connect.readyHint: Run this in a terminal, then start Claude Code and ask it anything about your work.
connect.readyTitle: Your key is ready. Copy it now: it won't be shown again.

keys.description: Every key acts as you, limited to its scope. Revoke any you no longer use.

full.hint: All your permissions except pay, audit, settings and people management.

tasks.hint: Create, edit, assign and organise tasks. Can't delete.

workspace.enableHint: Everyone in the workspace can use it, within their own permissions.
